name: Mitsuru Mura
source: A Japanese transfer student who joins the same gen-ed course as the protagonist. Friendly, pleasant, and eager to study. Marketing major. First name means "full, growing" — appropriate, given her particular situation. Nearly fluent in speaking English thanks to tutors and immersing herself in an English-speaking environment. Speaks with an accent. Close friends with Hannah, and is helping her socialize.
